name: Tavily
description: Remote MCP for web search and page extraction; OAuth (DCR/CIMD-capable host) or paste a Tavily API key.

setupSteps.title: Connect with OAuth
setupSteps.instructions: Click Connect and finish the browser flow. Tavily advertises dynamic registration on this host (CIMD-friendly).

setupSteps.title: Optional: dashboard key for OAuth
setupSteps.instructions: If you use Connect with OAuth, you can name a key mcp_auth_default in the dashboard to pick which Tavily key backs MCP calls.

setupSteps.title: Or paste an API key
setupSteps.instructions: Get a key at app.tavily.com (prefix tvly-). Use Save API key & Connect in the Apps modal — no browser OAuth required.
